messages:
maya: thinking of doing a dog-friendly hike Saturday morning + bakery stop vs just a lazy doughnut meetup. who’s in? :dog: :doughnut:
ben: hike sounds good if it’s under 6mi. will bring Miso (golden).
sam: doughnuts only for me, can’t function before coffee :coffee: 
tessa: i’ll do hike if there’s a guaranteed bakery afterwards. otherwise doughnuts.
maya: compromise idea — meet at Pine Ridge trailhead 9am for a short 2–3mi loop, optional bakery stop at Roll & Glaze ~11am. sound ok?
ana: small correction — i’m ana, not nana :) i can offer 2 seats if anyone needs a ride.
ben: @ana that would be awesome, thanks. where are you leaving from?
nana: leaving from Mission & 5th at 8:30. ping me if you need directions.
devops-bot: FYI please sign the group-hike waiver before joining: https://company/docs/hike-waiver
sam: signed ✅
lunch-bot: Poll: "Hike + Bakery" / "Doughnuts Only" / "Night In" — vote with emoji :1: :2: :3:
maya: current tally: Hike+Bakery 3, Doughnuts 1, Night In 0 (so far)
ben: bringing tick spray & granola bars. 
tessa: i’ll bring a small first-aid kit and a pack of napkins for the doughnuts :grimacing: 
maya: also PSA — pet-safe sunscreen pls, and leash leash leash.
ben: will post a tiny map pin in #random before leaving. see y’all saturday! :waves:
